title: It Keeps Burning, Man!
description: It Keeps Burning, Man! — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 25 Mutant Fire Pincers, 25 Mutant Pukers, 25 Mutant Fire Hulks, 25 Mutant Fire Twins in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and return to Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 25 Mutant Fire Pincers, 25 Mutant Fire Pukers, 25 Mutant Fire Hulks, and 25 Mutant Fire Twins in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Soldier Kwale in Algor's Staging Area.

Offer:

Ready for more? I guess it's safe to say you do not suffer from Arsonphobia. Well, when you are done these Fire Mutants will have Dungeon Runner-obia! Get it?!

Ok, that was not funny. But it was not funny on purpose! I suffer from Geliophobia which is a fear of laughter. I like to make jokes though and that means I have to intentionally make bad jokes. Did you hear the one about the Poison Orok Mystic and the lost Broodling? Oh, man, that one is really funny, but I can't tell it to you. Sorry. Sigh... Welcome to my life.

When you are done return to me, Soldier Kwale, here in the Algor Staging Area.

Turn-in:

Good job! If you are going to keep doing this quest you may want to invest in some sun screen.

Objectives:

  • Slain Fire Mutant Pincers
  • Slain Fire Mutant Pukers
  • Slain Fire Mutant Hulks
  • Slain Fire Mutant Twins

Level range: 10–25
